prompt: Create a high-fidelity production-ready portrait mobile WEB APP SCREENSHOT for Takara, Indonesian shared household finance app. Not a phone mockup, no device frame, no rendered physical scene. A full single 390px by 844px logical screen composition, rendered at high resolution portrait. User-specified design: soft sage green and milky white LIQUID GLASS, rounded floating capsule bottom navbar, airy and readable big monetary numbers, premium precise product UI, functional glass depth. Palette exact warmwhite #F5F8F3, sage #E4EDDF, mutedleaf #C7DAC0, forest text #2D503E. Use subtle translucent refracted glass mainly for bottom nav, balance panel and floating action, not card-inside-card nesting. Crisp familiar Jakarta Sans-like typography, dark high contrast text, consistent thin-line icons (no colorful emoji, no sparkles), generous whitespace and 44px comfortable controls. No purple, no giant decorative orbs, no gradients on text, no technical badges/AI marketing buzzwords. All data fictional. HEADER Takara with small household selector Rumah Kita and profile circle. Bottom NAV capsule, 5 standard items: Beranda, Transaksi, Dompet, Laporan, Setelan; Beranda selected in pale sage. Show visible friendly plus Catat affordance clear of navbar. PRIMARY CONTENT balance Rp8.450.000, labelled Saldo tersedia; income Rp6.000.000 and expense Rp1.550.000 labelled Masuk and Keluar. Household wallets Bank Jago Rp8.000.000 and Tunai Rp450.000. Recent transactions Kopi Pagi -Rp25.000; Gaji +Rp5.000.000; Belanja Harian -Rp185.000, with small clear times. No fabricated brand logos. Include a tiny Contoh label to indicate demonstration data. All words Bahasa Indonesia. Foreground controls must look buildable with semantic HTML and CSS, screen not an illustration. Full viewport no clipped footer. COMPOSITION B CATATAN HARIAN: Same EXACT visual world and typography as described. Balance occupies a shallow top band with large Rp8.450.000 and an eye control; income/outgoing sit in a single quiet horizontal baseline beneath. A strong + Catat pill sits right of the band. Most middle-screen area devoted to Aktivitas terbaru, grouped Hari ini then Kemarin with 5 generous transaction rows using clear left icons, descriptions, times and right-aligned amounts. A rounded search field and separate round filter icon immediately above list. Wallets as a small horizontal text strip above list, not competing cards. Five-item rounded glass navbar floats at bottom. No full-height hero, most screen is useful activity list. Glass appears on nav and balance band.
